sloka: सो अभिगम्य महात्मानः सर्वान् एव गुरोः सुतान् ।अभिवाद्य आनुपूर्व्येण ह्रिया किंचित् अवाङ्मुखः ॥१-५७-१६॥
transliteration: so abhigamya mahātmānaḥ sarvān eva guroḥ sutān ।abhivādya ānupūrvyeṇa hriyā kiṁcit avāṅmukhaḥ ॥1-57-16॥

translations.english: In response to his words the king, who had fallen into the state of a chandala yet proficient in expression, spoke to one (Viswamitra) expert in speech, with folded hands.
